set.body:
Outcome
Deliver reusable application structure without owning docking or scientific models.

Owned scope
meridian-workbench; sampler dataset/viewport/settings fixtures

Prerequisites
C1, C2, C3

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Provide navigation, location/view header, inspector sections and status/empty/loading/error compositions built from existing controls; no duplicate pane/title rows.
- [ ] Dataset browser, scientific viewport+inspector and settings/analysis form fixtures exercise populated, empty, loading, partial/error and recovery states.
- [ ] At 1280×800, 1024×700 and 800×600 all essential actions/details remain reachable; inspector collapse always has a labeled keyboard-accessible reopen action.
- [ ] Long paths/labels, negative/large numbers, missing values and validation messages have explicit layout behavior; no clipped required text under 200% text enlargement.
- [ ] Workbench-only sample compiles without ScalaDock; compositions expose semantic classes and do not retain application-specific scientific data.

Required evidence
Standalone workbench consumer compile, deterministic fixture state matrix and native recovery/resize checks.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code C4. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [C4] Finish optional workbench compositions and three realistic fixtures
